children: Elegancia Contracting and Industries (Elegancia C&I), part of Qatar Stock Exchange-listed Estithmar Holding, has been awarded the turnkey construction contract worth half a billion Qatari riyals ($137 million) to deliver an AI-ready data centre for MEEZA.
The contract will be delivered in two phases, Estithmar Holding said in a stock exchange statement.

Under the turnkey contract, Elegancia C&I will manage the full delivery lifecycle, including site preparation and civil works, structural and architectural construction, mechanical and electrical systems, ICT, security and fire protection, controls and monitoring integration, testing and commissioning, quality assurance, HSE compliance, and final handover.

The statement didn’t disclose the capacity or construction timeline but said Elegancia C&I will work with Elegancia Contracting, Elegancia Electromechanical Services (MEP), Elegancia Data Centre , Elegancia Steel and CESCO to deliver the project.
MEEZA, located in Qatar Science & Technology Park (QSTP), is a leading provider of data centre and Artificial Intelligence (AI) services in the Gulf state.

title: Qatar’s Elegancia C&I awarded $137mln turnkey contract for AI-ready data centre
